purpose: Freeze the strongest currently supportable winning-path candidate without changing the preregistered forward lane, consuming protected holdouts, or claiming profitability before genuine prospective price evidence exists.

best_current_candidate.name: SELECTIVE_SCORE_DOMINANCE_CONSERVATIVE_SINGLE_3RENHUKU_CORE_VALUE_LANE
race_selection: Use only complete reproducible PRE racecards before target result visibility.
Require the frozen S0/challenger top1 confidence gate exactly as preregistered: same top1 and conservative top1 probability >= 0.40.
Do not use Girls/final/solo/venue/class as purchase modifiers yet; log them as strata only.
best_current_candidate.ticket: Freeze exactly one highest-ranked top3 3renhuku ticket before any price lookup.
best_current_candidate.ticket_probability: Use min(S0 ticket probability, challenger ticket probability).
price: Require genuine current timestamped PRE odds after prediction freeze.
Only 1.0x-20.0x is eligible for a manual buy candidate in the current forward authority.
Current preregistered numeric CORE condition is p_ticket * decimal_odds >= 1.10.
>20.0x remains SHADOW_ONLY and never a manual buy candidate under the current forward authority.
best_current_candidate.stake: At most BUY_CANDIDATE_100YEN for Owner manual action; no automatic execution, no Kelly, no martingale, no loss chasing.
reason_this_is_currently_strongest: It concentrates on the strongest PRE-only score signal rather than broad race participation.
It keeps ticket count at one, avoiding probability dilution from adding lower-ranked combinations before price-specific evidence exists.
It rejects unverified prices and longshot-driven purchase behavior.
It preserves anti-hindsight ordering and can be falsified prospectively.

redundant_numeric_value_checks.finding: The current expected-ROI and probability-multiple thresholds are algebraically equivalent within each band, not two independent confirmations.
redundant_numeric_value_checks.proof: expected_roi = p*odds-1 and probability_multiple_vs_market = p/(1/odds)=p*odds. Therefore expected_roi>=0.10 iff p*odds>=1.10, exactly the same as probability_multiple>=1.10 in CORE; the same equality holds for the paired thresholds in the other bands.
redundant_numeric_value_checks.reason_no_change_now: Changing a frozen threshold after observations begin would create threshold drift/hindsight risk.
redundant_numeric_value_checks.future_unseen_lane: A later separately preregistered challenger should replace the redundant second numeric check with a genuinely independent uncertainty/calibration or evidence-quality criterion, learned without scored prospective outcomes.

fallback_consensus_is_not_independent_mo.finding: When exact rider lookup is absent, the challenger is only a small style/circumference perturbation of the same competition-score S0 signal, so same-top1 agreement is primarily a stability check rather than independent-model corroboration.
fallback_consensus_is_not_independent_mo.r5_example: Takeo 2026-09-11 R5 had zero exact-rider matches; S0 and challenger rankings were identical and top1 moved only from 0.540234324130 to 0.546389824251.
fallback_consensus_is_not_independent_mo.future_logging_recommendation: Record challenger support mode and exact-rider lookup coverage so later unseen evidence can distinguish true rider-supported corrections from fallback-only stability.

core_purchase_feasibility_floor.finding: A conservative ticket probability below 0.055 cannot qualify for a CORE manual buy candidate at any allowed CORE price, because the maximum CORE odds is 20.0 and the fixed value requirement is p*odds>=1.10.
core_purchase_feasibility_floor.use: Engineering shortcut/diagnostic only. It can identify CORE-impossible tickets without changing any preregistered decision. Shadow-data collection policy remains separate.

single_ticket_concentration.finding: Under the existing equal-budget uniform-odds screening formula, adding combinations whose individual model probability is lower than the current best ticket lowers average model probability per combination and therefore cannot improve the uniform minimum-odds requirement absent compensating price differences.
single_ticket_concentration.implication: Keep the one-point 3renhuku as the cleanest current model-side candidate until genuine ticket-specific PRE prices support a different portfolio rule.

falsification_requirements_before_any_st: Accumulate genuine prospective PRE price observations after immutable prediction freezes.
Measure purchase rate, hit rate, stake, return, net, recovery/ROI, longest losing streak and maximum drawdown.
Measure largest-winner and top3-winner profit concentration and recovery excluding the largest winning payout.
Report Girls/final/solo/venue/class strata without promoting a subgroup from the same scored sample.
Require a later unseen period to reproduce any discovered edge without threshold retuning.
Do not use protected DEV2000 C or ECON_HOLDOUT1000 without their separate legitimate gate.
next_without_owner: Preserve the current forward prespec unchanged for prospective evidence collection.
Add support-mode and CORE-feasibility diagnostics only in a non-decision-changing research layer if implementation work continues.
When legitimate future evidence is available, test whether the selective one-point CORE lane remains positive after drawdown and winner-concentration controls.
Only after sufficient clean evidence should a separately preregistered independent robustness challenger be considered.
